name: bmad-portal-vscode
description: IDE-native access to the BMad Portal Backend Hub: repo state polling, claims, and dashboard Web Views inside VS Code.

bmadPortal.backendHubUrl.description: Base URL of the BMad Portal Backend Hub this extension connects to (WebSocket/REST).

bmadPortal.repoPollingIntervalSec.description: Interval, in seconds, at which the extension polls local repo state (via vscode.git) and reports it to the Backend Hub.

bmadPortal.authMethod.description: Authentication method used to obtain the session token stored in VS Code Secret Storage.

bmadPortal.dashboardDisplayMode.description: How the BMad Portal dashboard is displayed.

bmadPortal.enableEventDrivenPolling.description: When true, a detected local Git event (commit, checkout, merge start) triggers an immediate state upload to the Backend Hub without disrupting the next scheduled poll.

bmadPortal.dashboardRefreshIntervalSec.description: Interval, in seconds, at which dashboard Web View widgets (repo state, claims, risk signals) refresh their data from the Backend Hub.
